basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old from Seattle, Washington, who recently discovered the world of Reddit. By day, I work as a graphic designer for a local marketing agency, and by night, I'm an avid reader with a newfound love for scented candles and romance novels. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring new cafes and bookstores around the city. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings or on my lunch breaks, always on the hunt for new and interesting discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge about scented candles and romance novels is mostly self-taught, fueled by personal interest and online research. After stumbling upon the LushCosmetics subreddit, I've been diving deeper into the world of fragrances and product comparisons.
